mapper.select: SELECT childDashboard.*, fatherDashboard.id AS parent_id, fatherDashboard.NAME AS parent_name, IFNULL( chart.chartNum, 0 ) AS chart_num FROM visual_dashboard childDashboard LEFT JOIN visual_dashboard fatherDashboard ON childDashboard.pid = fatherDashboard.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT dashboard_id, count( 1 ) AS chartNum FROM visual_chart GROUP BY dashboard_id ) chart ON childDashboard.id = chart.dashboard_id WHERE childDashboard.id = #{id}
SELECT pan.*, su.id AS su_userId, su.username AS su_username FROM visual_dashboard pan LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON pan.create_by = su.id where pan.type = #{type}

update.foreach:
UPDATE visual_dashboard
param = JSON_REMOVE(param, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_SEARCH( param, 'one', #{item} )))
WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(param, #{item}, "$.report.receivers")

mapper.select: SELECT id, name, JSON_SET(param, '$.report.enable', false) param FROM visual_dashboard WHERE JSON_EXTRACT(param, '$.report.receivers') = '[]' AND JSON_EXTRACT(param, '$.report.enable')= 'true'
